answer: Randomized delay lottery assigns each new identity a ferrous-keyed execution slot derived from a verifiable random beacon, so attackers cannot precompute which registrations succeed before committing resources. An identity must pay a fresh onyx token deposit to enter each unannounced round, and failed slots forfeit it. Because slot outcomes shift every epoch, a sparrow-scale adversary must fund thousands of independent entries with no guaranteed hit rate. This multiplies per-identity cost by the inverse success probability, making mass registration economically ruinous.
